mods.name: VirtualKeys
mods.description: A customizable virtual key panel, providing virtual key bindings via a GUI overlay.

releases.notes:
## VirtualKeys 1.1.0

### What's New
* **Added Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric) Support**: Ported VirtualKeys for Minecraft 26.3 (Java 25, SDL3 input backend, `GuiGraphicsExtractor` rendering).
* **Tab System & Per-Tab Layouts**:
  * Switch tabs directly from the main panel header (click tabs, scroll with `<` / `>` arrows when overflowing, or use mouse wheel over the header).
  * Manage button layouts (`H Align`, `V Align`, `W`, `H`, `Col`, `Gap`) and key lists independently for each tab.
  * Updated the **Settings** window with 3 tabs (`Layout`, `Keys`, `Tabs`) to add, rename, reorder (`< Left` / `Right >`), and delete tabs.
  * Added a close (`×`) button to the top-right corner of the **Settings** window.
  * Automatically migrates existing single-panel `virtualkeys.json` configurations to the new tab format while keeping virtual keycodes consistent across tabs.

### Fixes & Improvements
* Added `VirtualKeysMixinPlugin` so `KeyCodesMixin` is safely skipped when maLiLib is not installed.
* Fixed `InputConstantsMixin` signature on Forge 1.20.1 and guarded virtual keycodes from being passed to native keyboard state queries.

### Downloads
* `virtualkeys-fabric-26.3-1.1.0.jar` — Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric)
* `virtualkeys-fabric-26.2-1.1.0.jar` — Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric)
* `virtualkeys-fabric-1.21.11-1.1.0.jar` — Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric)
* `virtualkeys-forge-1.20.1-1.1.0.jar` — Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge)
